2. (1) All motor vehicle and motorcycle racing events of international standards
which are held from 9 September 2004 to 8 September 2010 are exempted from
entertainments duty.
(2) For the purpose of subparagraph (1), the term "motor vehicle and motorcycle

activities which have been given recognition by the Federation De L Automobile
(FIA) and the Federation International De Motorcyclisme (FIM).

(INSURANS  W AJIB ) (P INDAAN ) 2005
PADA menjalankan kuasa yang diberikan oleh seksyen 29 Akta Perkapalan
Saudagar (Pencemaran Minyak) 1994 [ Akta 515 ], Menteri membuat peraturan-
peraturan yang berikut:
Nama dan permulaan kuat kuasa
1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan
Perkapalan Saudagar (Pencemaran Minyak) (Insurans Wajib) (Pindaan)
(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 15 September 2005.
Pindaan peraturan 3
2. Peraturan-Peraturan Perkapalan Saudagar (Pencemaran Minyak) (Insurans
Wajib) 1995 [ P.U. (A) 102/1995 ], yang disebut "Peraturan-Peraturan ibu" dalam
Peraturan-Peraturan ini, dipinda dengan menggantikan subperaturan 3(2) dengan
subperaturan yang berikut:
"(2) Bagi maksud peraturan ini, "pelayaran Malaysia" ertinya apa-apa
pelayaran oleh sesuatu kapal—
(a) dari suatu pelabuhan, pangkalan atau tempat di mana-mana kawasan
di Malaysia  ke suatu pelabuhan, pangkalan atau tempat lain di mana-
mana kawasan di Malaysia;
(b) dari suatu pelabuhan, pangkalan atau tempat di mana-mana kawasan
di Malaysia ke suatu tempat di luar Malaysia; atau
(c) dari suatu tempat di luar Malaysia ke suatu pelabuhan, pangkalan atau
tempat di mana-mana kawasan di Malaysia,
dan sebutan mengenai tempoh pelayaran itu hendaklah dimaksudkan sebagai
merangkumi keseluruhan mana-mana tempoh semasa kapal itu terlibat dalam
pelayaran itu, termasuk pada bila-bila masa semasa, berkaitan dengan pelayaran
itu, kapal itu berada di suatu pelabuhan, pangkalan atau tempat di mana-mana
kawasan di Malaysia.".
Pindaan Jadual

MERCHANT SHIPPING (OIL POLLUTION) ACT 1994
MERCHANT  S HIPPING  (O IL P OLLUTION ) (C OMPULSORY  I NSURANCE )
(AMENDMENT ) R EGULATIONS  2005
IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 29 of the Merchant Shipping (Oil
Pollution) Act 1994 [ Act 515 ], the Minister makes the following regulations:
Citation and commencement
1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Merchant Shipping (Oil Pollution)
(Compulsory Insurance) (Amendment) Regulations 2005 .
(2) These Regulations come into operation on 15 September 2005.
Amendment of regulation 3
2. The Merchant Shipping (Oil Pollution) (Compulsory Insurance) Regulations
1995 [ P.U. (A) 102/1995 ], which in these Regulations are referred to as the
"principal Regulations", are amended by substituting for subregulation 3(2) the
following subregulation:
"(2) For the purposes of this regulation, "Malaysian voyage" means any
voyage by a ship—
(a) from a port, terminal or place in any area of Malaysia to another port,
terminal or place in any area of Malaysia;
(b) from a port, terminal or place in any area of Malaysia to a place
outside Malaysia; or
(c) from a place outside Malaysia to a port, terminal or place in any area
of Malaysia,
and the reference to the duration of such a voyage shall be taken as comprising
the whole of any period during which the ship is engaged in that voyage,
including any time during which, in connection with the voyage, it is in a port,
terminal or place in any area of Malaysia.".
Amendment of Schedule
3. The principal Regulations are amended by substituting for the Schedule the
following schedule:
P.U. (A) 340.

SECURITIES COMMISSION ACT 1993
SECURITIES  C OMMISSION  (A MENDMENT  OF S CHEDULE  1) O RDER  2005
IN exercise of the powers prescribed by subsection 32 A(4) of the Securities
Commission Act 1993 [ Act 498 ], the Minister makes the following order:
Citation
1. This order may be cited as the Securities Commission (Amendment of
Schedule 1) Order 2005 .
P.U. (A) 343.
Amendment of Schedule 1
2. Schedule 1 to the Securities Commission Act 1993 is amended—
(a) in paragraph 6, by inserting after the words "Securities Industry Act
1983" the words "or such other exchange outside Malaysia which is
recognized under the rules of an exchange approved by the Minister
pursuant to subsection 8(2) of the Securities Industry Act 1983";
(b) in paragraph 12, by inserting after the words "made to existing holders
of those securities" the words "or made to a person falling within
paragraph 9, 10 or 11 of Schedule 2"; and
(c) by inserting after paragraph 15 the following paragraph:
"16. All trades in foreign currency denominated debentures
and Islamic securities effected as may be specified by the
Commission.".
Made 7 September 2005
[KK/BPKA/K2/(S)/483/1/5; PN(PU 2)523/III]
TAN S RI N OR M D BIN Y AKCOP
Second Minister of Finance

makes the following order:
Citation

Schedule 2 and Schedule 3)  Order 2005 .

recognized under the rules of an exchange approved by the Minister
pursuant to subsection 8(2) of the Securities Industry Act 1983"; and
(b) in paragraph 20, by inserting after the words "to employees" the
words "or directors".
P.U. (A) 344.
Amendment of Schedule 3

(a) in paragraph 15, by inserting after the words "Securities Industry Act
1983" the words "or such other exchange outside Malaysia which is
recognized under the rules of an exchange approved by the Minister
pursuant to subsection 8(2) of the Securities Industry Act 1983";
(b) In paragraph 20, by inserting after the words "to employees" the
words "or directors";
(c) in paragraph 27, by inserting after the words "under this Act" the
words "or in respect of which the securities to which the option,
warrant or transferable subscription right converts into are listed
securities"; and
(d) in paragraph 28, by inserting after the words "under this Act" the
words; "or in respect of which the securities to which the convertible
note converts into are listed securities".
Made 7 September 2005
[KK/BPKA/K2/(S)/483/1/5; PN(PU 2)523/III]
